items.en: Tell me about yourself. — I'm an animation student in my final year…
What are your strengths? — I'm organized and I work well in a team.
What's your main weakness? — I'm a perfectionist, but I'm learning to manage my time.
Why do you want this job? — Because I want to grow in a creative company.
Do you have any questions? — Yes, what does a typical day look like?

slides.title: Question and best answer
pairs: Because I have the skills and the motivation you need.
Where do you see yourself in five years?
Leading a small team of designers.
Yes, I met tight deadlines in my last project.
